items.text:
Your medical receptionist costs you $40K+ a year.

And spends 30–50% of that time just answering phones.

Last week, I built an AI agent that does the whole job — without breaks, sick days, or context-switching:

→ Books, reschedules, and cancels appointments
→ Verifies insurance + checks eligibility in real-time
→ Collects co-pays and sends payment reminders
→ Handles incoming calls 24/7 (after-hours too)
→ Updates patient records directly in your EHR
→ Sends appointment reminders that cut no-shows in half
→ Manages referrals and billing inquiries
→ Speaks every language your patients do

It never forgets. Never burns out. Never quits.

The healthcare industry has spent billions on burnout fixes. Turns out the answer was simpler:

Stop assigning humans to robot work.

If your front desk is drowning — DM me the word "AGENT" and I'll send a 5-minute demo.

#Healthcare #AI #MedicalPractice #Automation
